## Responsibility

`AgentHost` that plays an `AgentScenario` instead of calling a model (ADR-0051): `run drive --host scenario` with `METATOR_AGENT_SCENARIO=<file>`. It drives whole workflows in tests, demos and workflow CI; it is not a model and decides nothing.

## Invariants

- The n-th start of an agent plays its n-th entry and the last entry repeats [[cite: packages/plugin-host-scenario/src/scenario-agent-host.ts:58 | "const steps = entries[Math.min(n, entries.length - 1)] ?? [];"]].
- A missing or invalid scenario is a failed result, never a throw.

## Allowed dependencies

`@metator/core` and `yaml`, like every plugin (MT-ARCH-006).

## Pitfalls

- A loop that comes back to an agent needs its own entry, or the last one repeats.
- `write` paths are relative to the agent's working directory (the run's worktree) unless they start with `{runDir}`.
